held_new.title: Stale ref blocks resume
held_new.reason: Verified against the new head. Resume fact 1 (lines 43-47) specifies `git merge-base --is-ancestor <base-tip> <default-ref>` with `<default-ref>` = `origin/<default>` for a remote target, and states NO freshness obligation: grep -niE 'fetch|refresh|up-to-date|stale' over runtime/mission-chaining.md returns NO MATCHES. The bot's cited precedent holds verbatim - runtime/scripts/preflight.py:21-22 reads 'An online default derived from gh resolves through refs/remotes/origin/<branch>, never a possibly stale local namesake. Fetch origin before running preflight;' - so the repo's sibling policy already carries exactly the discipline this new clause omits. Failure mode is concrete and one-directional: a coordinator whose origin/<default> predates the human's landed promotion gets --is-ancestor false and keeps the chain PARKED-AT-PROMOTION although promotion HAS landed. It fails safe (never a wrong resume) but it strands a legitimately resumable chain behind a human gate, and the doc's own rule says 'A coordinator may not resume its own promotion park' - so nothing downstream recovers it.
held_new.note_for_batch: REGRESSION-ADJACENT: this defect lives in the clause F-1 rewrote to close round-1 BOT-1. The r2 fix corrected the ancestry ENDPOINTS (BASE->DEFAULT) but inherited the unfetched-ref assumption from the text it replaced. Treat as a continuation of BOT-1's clause, not an unrelated new finding.

held_new.title: Harness fixture is missing
held_new.reason: Verified by reading the harness and the index. Line 6 `BASE = Path('base-policy.md').read_text()` executes unconditionally at MODULE IMPORT, before any mutant selection; line 32 consumes it for the 'base-policy' mutant. Nothing in the file ever writes base-policy.md (grep for write_text finds only POLICY.write_text at lines 96/98, which target runtime/mission-chaining.md). The fixture is neither git-tracked (`git ls-files | grep base-policy` empty) nor present on disk, while the harness itself IS tracked. So a clean checkout raises FileNotFoundError at import and reproduces ZERO of the 13 mutants - not merely the base-policy one.
held_new.scope: inside this unit's own evidence (docs/reports/U-CHAIN/), not the frozen spec
held_new.note_for_batch: Severity is understated relative to THIS repo's doctrine. AGENTS.md makes an independent verifier re-deriving the facts the definition of done, and the 13/13 mutant battery is this unit's convergence evidence for #441/#443/#444. A harness that cannot run from a clean checkout makes that battery unreproducible by the verifier it exists to satisfy. The recorded mutants-r2.txt output is not thereby falsified - it is simply no longer independently re-derivable. Cheap fix (derive BASE from `git show <sha>:runtime/mission-chaining.md`) is available but was NOT applied - held per dispatch.
